### No More Whoring
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/no-more-whoring
Passage: Numbers 15:39-40
Points:
- God instructed the Israelites to place tassels on their garments to steer their wandering eyes and hearts back to His commands.
- Believers still face an intense inward struggle against the persistent pull of sinful desires.
- The cross replaces physical tassels by reminding us that Christ perfectly fulfilled the law on our behalf.
- Our daily war against sin will finally end when we are made completely whole in glory.

### Yellow Ribbon Round Your Tree
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-6-2009-11603208.html
Passage: Numbers 15:38-39
Points:
- Just like ribbons serve as visual reminders, God instructed Israel to wear tassels so they would remember to obey Him.
- People constantly battle between yielding to their own immediate wishes and responding to God's leadings.
- Hesitating or delaying obedience can cause believers to miss out on the Lord's purposes and blessings.
- Establishing modern practical reminders, such as verse cards or alarms, helps redirect our focus back to God each day.
